cases.name: etaf-solitaire-waste-activation-follows-the-displayed-card
cases.purpose: Browsing updates a retained waste control, whose activation selects the currently displayed card without submitting a native move.

cases.name: etaf-solitaire-embedded-escape-releases-the-host-after-selection
cases.purpose: Embedded help and card selection each consume one Escape before the enclosing host receives dismissal, preserving the native deal.

cases.name: etaf-solitaire-help-entries-preserve-the-selected-card
cases.purpose: All help entries share an in-buffer searchable modal, restore focus and keep the selected card usable without changing the deal.

cases.name: etaf-solitaire-help-survives-native-move-publication
cases.purpose: An asynchronous OpenSpiel move publishes under help without replacing its snapshot or stealing focus; undo remains usable after closing.

cases.name: etaf-solitaire-card-input-moves-native-cards-and-restores-history
cases.purpose: Card and foundation activation move native cards; undo/redo restore the same deal.

cases.name: etaf-solitaire-themes-and-resize-preserve-the-deal
cases.purpose: Repeated keyboard and button theme switches and narrow layouts preserve the game, card dimensions and selected move.

cases.name: etaf-solitaire-escape-dismisses-the-selection
cases.purpose: Framework Escape clears a picked card without changing the deal; the later target press stays inert.
